Groups into Single-Elimination |prizepool= |tournaments=4on4 |entrance= |website= |sdate=2000-01-21 |edate=2000-04-29 |twitch= |teamfirst=Flaming Fist |teamfirstflag=se |teamsecond=CAPSLOCK |teamsecondflag=se |teamthird=Euthanasia |teamthirdflag=se |teamthird2=Clan Malfunction |teamthird2flag=fi |map1=dm2 |map2=dm3 |map3=e1m2 }} == Introduction == * Round: Villains 2 - Group 4 * Match: {{Flag/se}} [[Orkney Clan]] vs {{Flag/hu}} [[Zion]] * Date: 2000-02-05 == Match report == === DM3 === OC: 130 - ZION: 57
[[Image:Oc-zion-dm3.jpg|320px]]
Map pick by Orkney Clan.

Demos: [https://www.quakeworld.nu/w/images/e/e2/Oc_vs_zion_dm3-1-bizz.qwz bizz (OC)]

"Well, I had not seen anything from clan Orkney since their participation in the Heroes league, more than a year ago. So I really didn't know what to expect. A nice and fair server was found, kt.euro.net in Holland, very good ... both teams had chosen DM3. First round began with ZION spawning both quad and pent. Orkney took to RA and built up. By the time of the next quad, OC was there but was beaten of by RL equipped ZION:ists. ZION picks up some speed, holding the rl/ya and bridge-area. OC keeps to RA and hangs around circle. 18 mins to go sees ZION in the lead by 5. OC then attacks and takes ya and the quadarea. Taking the next quad, OC drives some of ZION's players away from RA and SNG. 15 mins left, OC have taken the lead by 7 frags. OC gets the second pent but ZION manages to steal the quad from under the pent-guys nose (that player was of course killed, but still). OC pretty much keeping armor control from then on, taking the next quad and clearing the bridge at regular intervals. 13 mins left and they have a 17 frag lead. As OC stock up at RA, ZION takes the next quad and attack. OC pull through and gets the next powerup. 10 mins left, OC in the lead by 28. ZION gets pent and takes RA and YA. OC quickly move in as soon as pent is out and retake the RA, keeping it tighter now, they also get the next quad. 8 minutes left and they have increased their lead to 45 frags. They keep taking the quads and holds both armors pretty well. Around the 14:th minute, ZION attacks the bridge and YA. With 5 mins left, OC lead by 72 frags. OC take the last pent, they are still guarding RA closely. ZION and OC trading fire over the circle, ZION takes the quad but bores with life shortly after. ZION makes a small comeback at the end, taking both armors and getting the quad; and another suicide. But the game is over and clearly to OC's favor." -Ego === DM3-2 === OC: 155 - ZION: 38
[[Image:Oc-zion-dm3-2.jpg|320px]]
Map pick by Zion.

Demos: [https://www.quakeworld.nu/w/images/f/f7/Oc_vs_zion_dm3-2-bizz.qwz bizz (OC)]

"Next round I predicted would be much more even since I figured that ZION was just surprised over OC playing so well ... but I guess I was wrong. ZION started out with another good start, both pent and quad again. OC quickly secured RA after that, and they took the next quad with some ease. ZION keeping by the YA fought back and took another quad as soon as it appeared. 17 minutes to go, OC up by 7. Then ZION takes RA and it is clear that they intend to keep it. OC shows that they are very intent to take it back and start working on it. 15 minutes left, OC up by 11. ZION takes the pent but OC the quad. OC clear RL and bridge and take YA. For the next quad, OC shows great coordination by amassing all their players on both sides of the circle, trapping ZION in the RA and getting an easy quad. They then launch a full-scale assault into RA and kill the ZION players there. 13 minutes left and they are in the lead by 17. They keep holding RA and taking the quad without much resistance from ZION who tries two discharges in the water to kill OC's quad but fail both attempts. OC now has a limited control of the level, they also get the next pent. 9 minutes to go and we see OC in the lead by 56 frags. They keep harvesting the quads ... almost too easily. Clearing the bridge and rl-box when they need to. 6 minutes left, OC leads by 81. ZION snags the next pent in a tight struggle and momentarily take RA. OC keeps getting the quads though and there isn't much to hold them back. 3 minutes left, OC up by 98. They now hold RA, YA and keep checks on the bridge ... Game Over ZION ! Good game to both teams! OC surprising with very proficient play! ZION didn't look quite as good as in their game against FX earlier that night, maybe they had worn themselves out? Anyway, two nice rounds with much more to come!" -Ego == Summary == * Score: 2-0 * Total frags ** OC: 285 ** ZION: 95 __NOTOC__ [[Category:Matchreports]]
